title: N-glycan profiles of A549 and BEAS-2B small extracellular vesicles and culture media
description: GlycoGenius-derived N-glycan abundance profiles from tumorigenic A549 and non-tumorigenic BEAS-2B small extracellular vesicles, with BEGM and F12 culture-medium profiles from the same study.
details: All four source profile columns are retained. These are single profiles rather than six-replicate glycoproteomic measurements reported elsewhere in the paper. Migration-time-filtered assignments can contain alternative compositions separated by slashes; those alternatives remain explicit and are not arbitrarily resolved. Missing medium signals remain NA. This accession shares its publication with GPST000562, whose CS/DS disaccharides are represented separately because the glycan type and quantification differ.
annotation: H, N and F encode Hex, HexNAc and Fuc. Am and E encode derivatized alpha2,3 and alpha2,6 Neu5Ac; native NeuAc totals are represented as composition, and derivative/linkage counts are retained. Phosphorylation is retained where explicitly reported. Features with incompatible alternative compositions have missing typed composition and retain every author candidate.
